Design and build AI/ML and Generative AI solutions using LLMs, RAG pipelines, and vector databases. Develop, train, and deploy models, implement prompt engineering, and manage MLOps pipelines for scalable production systems.



Required Candidate profile

Experience in Python, ML/DL frameworks, and LLM-based applications. Hands-on with LangChain/RAG, vector DBs, and MLOps. Ability to build scalable AI solutions and work on enterprise GenAI use cases.

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Generative AI Engineer to join our team at Luxoft India LLP. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in artificial intelligence and machine learning, with experience in generating AI models.


Roles and Responsibility



Design and develop generative AI models for various applications.


Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI models into existing systems.


Develop and implement data preprocessing and feature engineering techniques.


Train and test AI models using large datasets.


Optimize model performance using hyperparameter tuning and other techniques.


Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI and deep learning.



Job Requirements



Strong understanding of artificial intelligence and machine learning concepts.


Experience with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.


Knowledge of programming languages such as Python or Java.


Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.


Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.


Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

Role & responsibilities




Experience: 5+ years in software engineering with strong hands-on experience in AI, Generative AI and Agentic AI.
Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production-grade AI/LLM applications.
Hands-on expertise in LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases and semantic search.
Experience building AI Agents, multi-agent workflows, tool/function calling, MCP and agent orchestration using LangChain/LangGraph/LlamaIndex or similar.
Strong experience with OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or open-source LLMs, along with AI evaluation and guardrails.
Experience deploying scalable AI solutions on Azure/AWS/GCP, with REST APIs, Docker/Kubernetes and CI/CD.

Senior AI Developer (GCP / Google ADK / Vertex AI / RAG)

Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
Proven experience building AI agents using Google Agent Development Kit (ADK)
Expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures

Design and develop enterprise-scale Agentic AI solutions using Google ADK and Vertex AI.
Build and optimize RAG pipelines for enterprise knowledge retrieval.
Develop multi-agent workflows and autonomous decision-making systems.
Integrate LLMs, vector databases, and enterprise systems.
Implement monitoring, evaluation, security, and governance for AI applications.
Collaborate with architects and business stakeholders to define AI solutions.

Ideal Experience

8+ years of software development experience
3+ years in Generative AI/LLM solutions
2+ years of hands-on Vertex AI implementation
Experience delivering production-grade AI applications on GCP.

Role & responsibilities




Role Summary

The role focuses on building intelligent automation using Power Platform, leveraging Azure AI services, and accelerating development with GitHub Copilot. The ideal candidate will have strong Generative AI (GenAI) expertise with handson experience in developing agentic AI solutions, autonomous agents, and AI-driven bots using Microsoft Copilot Studio and the Azure AI ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

Microsoft Copilot Studio

Build low-code apps and workflows using Microsoft Copilot Studio.
Develop intelligent bots, conversational agents, and enterprise copilots using Copilot Studio and Azure AI orchestration.
Integrate Dataverse, Graph APIs, and other enterprise systems within Power Platform solutions.

Azure AI & Agentic AI

Leverage Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Cognitive Services, Azure Functions, and Logic Apps for AI-powered automation.
Design and deploy agentic AI systems supporting: 
Multi-step autonomous task execution
Reasoning-based workflows
RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
AI Orchestrators & Skills using Azure AI Studio
Build reusable autonomous agents for monitoring, decision-making, and workflow automation.

Bot & Agent Deployment

Build, test, and deploy AI-powered bots and agents across Teams, web, and enterprise applications.
Configure grounding, knowledge sources, skills, and secure execution policies for agents.
Ensure safe, responsible, and compliant agent behaviour.

Developer Productivity

Use GitHub Copilot in VS Code to accelerate development for .NET, C#, PowerShell, and Power Platform extensions.
Develop automation scripts, connectors, and reusable components.

Must-Have Skills

Hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio for bot and agent development.
Strong understanding of Generative AI concepts: prompt engineering, grounding, RAG, and Responsible AI.
Experience building agentic AI workflows and autonomous agents.
Power Platform expertise: Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse.
Familiarity with Azure AI stack: OpenAI Service, Cognitive Services, Functions, Logic Apps.
Proficiency with GitHub Copilot in VS Code (.NET, C#, automation scripts).
Knowledge of Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, and Teams integration.

Nice-to-Have

Experience with Azure DevOps, Power BI, and BFSI domain processes.
Experience with agentic design patterns, reusable prompts, and AI skill orchestration.
Hands-on work with Teams bots, custom connectors, or enterprise AI assistants.






Preferred candidate profile

Job Summary

Design and build production retrieval-augmented generation systems that answer questions from enterprise content accurately and securely.

What you'll do
Design RAG pipelines: ingestion, parsing, chunking, embeddings and hybrid search
Implement permission-aware retrieval and metadata filtering
Build evaluation sets and measure retrieval and answer quality
Optimise latency and cost; implement caching and model routing
Deploy and monitor RAG services in the cloud
Mentor junior engineers

3-6 years of software engineering experience, including at least 1-2 years with LLM applications
Strong Python and API development skills
Hands-on experience with vector databases and embeddings
Experience with at least one of Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI or Vertex AI
Understanding of evaluation methods for LLM and RAG systems
Nice to have
Experience with Azure AI Search, OpenSearch or pgvector at scale
LLMOps and tracing tools (Langfuse, LangSmith)
Document AI (Textract, Document Intelligence)

Amazon Bedrock
Azure OpenAI
pgvector

Hyderabad, Telangana, India
